title: Leader crashes, twice
description: Crashes profile, seed 5. S2 leads term 1 until its machine crashes at 1.0 s; S1 wins term 2, then crashes at 2.2 s; S3 wins term 3. Watch the pre-vote and vote rounds after each timeout, and the logs converging after restarts.

title: Leader cut off by a partition
description: Partitions profile, seed 35. The leader, S1, is isolated at 0.5 s. S3 runs a pre-vote round, wins term 2 at 0.66 s, and the cluster carries on, while S1 still believes it leads term 1 but can commit nothing. When the partition heals at 2.34 s, S1 hears term 2, steps down and catches up.

title: Without pre-vote: an isolated follower disrupts the leader
description: Partitions profile, seed 4, with pre-vote switched off (-bug no-prevote). S3 is isolated from 2.2 s to 3.0 s and keeps timing out, raising its term to 7. When it rejoins, its higher term forces the healthy leader S1 to step down, and S1 wins term 8. The simulator found this problem; see docs/bugs/005.

title: With pre-vote: the same partition, no disruption
description: The same seed with pre-vote on. While isolated, S3 only runs pre-vote rounds, which raise no terms. When it rejoins, it is still in term 1, the leader S1 is never deposed, and S3 simply catches up.

title: Membership changes
description: Calm profile with -membership, seed 2. Starting from S1-S3, the admin client adds S4, removes S2 (the leader, which steps down; S1 takes over in term 2), adds S5, removes S4 and adds S2 back, one server at a time.

title: Planted bug: no fsync (violation)
description: Crashes profile, seed 13, with -bug fsync: servers never fsync their term and vote. S2, the leader of term 1, has its machine crash at 1.6 s and loses its unsynced writes; when it restarts at 1.76 s its term has gone back from 1 to 0, and the term-monotonic invariant catches it.
